resources.title: What We Believe About the Five Points of Calvinism
resources.author: John Piper (Desiring God)
resources.note: The classic Calvinist statement, walking through each point with Scripture. If you lean the other way, pair it with Roger Olson's Arminian Theology.

resources.title: Chosen by God
resources.author: R.C. Sproul
resources.note: The clearest single-volume case for election. Short chapters, written for ordinary readers.

resources.title: Understanding Baptism
resources.author: Bobby Jamieson (9Marks)
resources.note: A 100-page walkthrough of the believer's-baptism position: what it is, who it is for, and why churches practice it.

resources.title: Baptism: Three Views
resources.author: ed. David F. Wright (IVP Spectrum)
resources.note: Believer's, infant, and dual-practice views argued side by side with responses — the fastest way to see the whole debate.

resources.title: Are Signs and Wonders for Today?
resources.author: John Piper (Desiring God)
resources.note: Piper's continuationist case from Scripture — a good entry point before the longer books.

resources.title: Surprised by the Power of the Spirit
resources.author: Jack Deere
resources.note: The book that moved many cessationists. For the other side, read John MacArthur's Strange Fire.

resources.title: The Meaning of the Millennium
resources.author: ed. Robert Clouse
resources.note: Four evangelical views of the thousand years debated in one volume — start here for the map.

resources.title: A Case for Amillennialism
resources.author: Kim Riddlebarger
resources.note: The strongest single-view defense of the amillennial reading, clearly argued.

resources.title: What Is Covenant Theology?
resources.author: Ligonier Ministries
resources.note: A short primer on reading the whole Bible as one covenant story.

resources.title: God's Big Picture
resources.author: Vaughan Roberts
resources.note: Traces the Bible's storyline from Genesis to Revelation in under 170 pages.

resources.title: The Chicago Statement on Biblical Inerrancy
resources.author: International Council on Biblical Inerrancy (1978)
resources.note: The landmark evangelical definition of inerrancy — short, precise, and still the reference point.

resources.title: Taking God At His Word
resources.author: Kevin DeYoung
resources.note: Why the Bible can be trusted, is necessary, and is enough. Very readable.

resources.title: Worship Matters
resources.author: Bob Kauflin
resources.note: Practical and pastoral — what gathered worship is for and how to lead it well.

resources.title: Christ-Centered Worship
resources.author: Bryan Chapell
resources.note: How the gospel itself shapes every element of the service, from call to worship to benediction.

resources.title: What Is a Healthy Church?
resources.author: Mark Dever (9Marks)
resources.note: Nine marks of church health in about 100 pages — the fastest orientation to ecclesiology.

resources.title: Church Membership
resources.author: Jonathan Leeman (9Marks)
resources.note: What belonging to a local church means and how churches should be led.

resources.title: 50 Crucial Questions About Manhood and Womanhood
resources.author: John Piper & Wayne Grudem
resources.note: Short answers to the fifty most-asked questions — the complementarian position in digestible pieces.

resources.title: Recovering Biblical Manhood and Womanhood
resources.author: ed. Piper & Grudem
resources.note: The landmark complementarian volume. For the egalitarian case, see Discovering Biblical Equality.

resources.title: Can I Lose My Salvation?
resources.author: R.C. Sproul (Ligonier, Crucial Questions)
resources.note: 65 pages on whether a true Christian can fall away — the unforgivable sin, false converts, and ongoing sin.

resources.title: Saved Without a Doubt
resources.author: John MacArthur
resources.note: How Scripture says you can know you are secure in Christ.

resources.title: What Is the Lord's Supper?
resources.author: Bobby Jamieson (9Marks)
resources.note: A clear, brief guide to the meaning of communion from a Baptist perspective.

resources.title: Short Treatise on the Lord's Supper
resources.author: John Calvin (1541)
resources.note: Calvin's own concise statement of the Reformed view — the classic alternative to memorialism.

resources.title: The Pursuit of Holiness
resources.author: Jerry Bridges
resources.note: The modern classic on our role in becoming holy — practical without being moralistic.

resources.title: The Hole in Our Holiness
resources.author: Kevin DeYoung
resources.note: Why holiness matters, why we avoid the word, and how grace actually changes us.

amcpherson.author: Aimee Semple McPherson
amcpherson.note: Her own story of the ministry that launched the Foursquare movement.
amcpherson.title: This Is That

barth.author: Karl Barth
barth.note: Short, late Barth — the most accessible door into his theology of the Word.
barth.title: Evangelical Theology: An Introduction

bcrawford.author: Robert E. Coleman
bcrawford.note: Crawford hasn't published a book — this short classic on Jesus' method of disciple-making fits his evangelistic calling.
bcrawford.title: The Master Plan of Evangelism

bgraham.author: Billy Graham
bgraham.note: His classic presentation of the gospel message he preached to millions.
bgraham.title: Peace with God

bonhoeffer.author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
bonhoeffer.note: Cheap grace versus costly grace, written as the Nazis rose.
bonhoeffer.title: The Cost of Discipleship

calvin.author: John Calvin
calvin.note: The systematic backbone of Reformed theology. Book 3 on faith and prayer is the most readable entry point.
calvin.title: Institutes of the Christian Religion

cknechtle.author: Cliffe Knechtle
cknechtle.note: Forty of the toughest questions he faces as a campus evangelist, answered with clarity.
cknechtle.title: Give Me an Answer

cscofield.author: C.I. Scofield
cscofield.note: The study Bible whose notes spread dispensational theology across the English-speaking world.
cscofield.title: The Scofield Reference Bible

cwalther.author: C.F.W. Walther
cwalther.note: His famous evening lectures — the Lutheran art of rightly dividing the Word.
cwalther.title: The Proper Distinction Between Law and Gospel

edwards.author: Jonathan Edwards
edwards.note: His searching test for genuine faith versus mere religious emotion.
edwards.title: Religious Affections

eelliot.author: Elisabeth Elliot
eelliot.note: The story of the five missionaries martyred in Ecuador, and the faith that followed.
eelliot.title: Through Gates of Splendor

jmacarthur.author: John MacArthur
jmacarthur.note: His landmark defense of lordship salvation — faith that submits, not just assents.
jmacarthur.title: The Gospel According to Jesus

jpokluda.author: Jonathan Pokluda
jpokluda.note: His bestselling guide to navigating faith, work, and relationships as a young adult.
jpokluda.title: Welcome to Adulting

jstott.author: John Stott
jstott.note: The clear, careful introduction to the faith that discipled a generation.
jstott.title: Basic Christianity

lewis.author: C.S. Lewis
lewis.note: The classic case for the core of Christian faith, from wartime radio talks.
lewis.title: Mere Christianity

luther.author: Martin Luther
luther.note: Luther's fiercest defense of grace alone against Erasmus — the book he said mattered most.
luther.title: The Bondage of the Will

menno.author: Menno Simons
menno.note: The Anabaptist vision in its founder's voice: discipleship, nonviolence, the church as a holy community.
menno.title: The Complete Writings of Menno Simons

moody.author: D.L. Moody
moody.note: A short, practical classic on prayer from the great evangelist.
moody.title: Prevailing Prayer

packer.author: J.I. Packer
packer.note: The modern classic on the character of God and what it means to truly know him.
packer.title: Knowing God

piper.author: John Piper
piper.note: The book that launched Christian Hedonism: God is most glorified when we are most satisfied in him.
piper.title: Desiring God

ppalmer.author: Phoebe Palmer
ppalmer.note: Her biblical defense of women's ministry and the higher Christian life.
ppalmer.title: The Promise of the Father

rmadu.author: Jack Deere
rmadu.note: Madu hasn't published a book — this charismatic classic best represents the stream he preaches in.
rmadu.title: Surprised by the Power of the Spirit

shauerwas.author: Stanley Hauerwas
shauerwas.note: His signature argument that the church's first political task is to be the church.
shauerwas.title: A Community of Character

sknechtle.author: Cliffe & Stuart Knechtle
sknechtle.note: How your deepest questions can lead to life-giving faith — from the father-son evangelism team.
sknechtle.title: Demolishing Doubt

sproul.author: R.C. Sproul
sproul.note: His signature work — the transcendence of God made vivid.
sproul.title: The Holiness of God

spurgeon.author: Charles Spurgeon
spurgeon.note: A short, direct invitation to trust Christ — pure Spurgeon.
spurgeon.title: All of Grace

tkeller.author: Tim Keller
tkeller.note: Belief in an age of skepticism — his landmark work of urban apologetics.
tkeller.title: The Reason for God

tozer.author: A.W. Tozer
tozer.note: His most beloved work — a call to intimate, unhurried knowledge of God.
tozer.title: The Pursuit of God

wesley.author: John Wesley
wesley.note: Wesley's own summary of entire sanctification, in his own plain words.
wesley.title: A Plain Account of Christian Perfection

whuff.author: F.F. Bruce
whuff.note: Huff hasn't published a book — this is the classic defense of manuscript reliability his ministry builds on.
whuff.title: The New Testament Documents: Are They Reliable?

wright.author: N.T. Wright
wright.note: His most readable map of why Christianity makes sense.
wright.title: Simply Christian

sfurtick.author: Steven Furtick
sfurtick.title: Sun Stand Still
sfurtick.note: His call to “audacious faith” — the book that made Elevation’s theology famous.

mmiller.author: Michael Miller
mmiller.title: His House, His Presence
mmiller.note: His 2023 book on ministry to the Lord as every believer’s first and primary calling.

cgroeschel.author: Craig Groeschel
cgroeschel.title: Winning the War in Your Mind
cgroeschel.note: His bestselling guide to renewing the mind and mastering everyday habits.

bjohnson.author: Bill Johnson
bjohnson.title: When Heaven Invades Earth
bjohnson.note: The book-length case that signs and wonders are the normal Christian life.

mchandler.author: Matt Chandler
mchandler.title: The Explicit Gospel
mchandler.note: His clearest statement of Calvinist soteriology for ordinary believers.

astanley.author: Andy Stanley
astanley.title: Deep and Wide
astanley.note: The playbook for seeker-sensitive multisite ministry.

rwarren.author: Rick Warren
rwarren.title: The Purpose Driven Life
rwarren.note: One of the bestselling books in history; forty days of purpose.

tevans.author: Tony Evans
tevans.title: Kingdom Man
tevans.note: His call for men to live under God’s comprehensive kingdom rule.

dplatt.author: David Platt
dplatt.title: Radical
dplatt.note: The 2010 challenge to American comfort Christianity that made him a missions voice.
